scenario: dry best-lap potential, not grid positions
limitations: No 2026 Singapore data or weather forecast used; dry scenario only.
Speed differentials are converted approximately to lap-time percentages with unit slope.
Baku retains its unresolved Russell baseline warning; a no-Baku sensitivity is saved.
Sepang GAS/COL/BOT fastest laps are excluded: Alpine retains earlier form, Cadillac uses PER only for round 16.
Historical sessions and category definitions differ; remaining Singapore classes are provisional.
Pole calibration uses the archived 2025 audit for rounds 1-11; their 2025 weather was not independently reverified.
Absolute-time error is estimated from walk-forward historical cases, not a confidence interval.
The latest available Sepang roster is assumed; no temporary Zandvoort driver substitutions are carried forward.
Milliseconds are output precision, not prediction accuracy; no practice anchor is yet available for Singapore.
